about: Same-hand bands for the sound layer, merged into the fingerprint's tolerance block by fingerprint.py (same shape as bands.json: rel is a share of the source value never narrower than abs_min, abs is a fixed +- width). Only scalar paths live here. Per-class comparisons (class mix, per-class level, centroid, duration, attack and decay, bound property share) depend on which classes a source has, so compare.py scores them with its SOUND constants, which match the per_class block below. Widths sit above what sound.py can measure (onset within 10 ms, level within 1 dB, pan within 0.05 on the synthetic fixture) and below what a listener hears as a different hand.

sound.density_per_10s.why: how often a sound lands is the first thing that reads as over- or under-scored

sound.sync.median_offset_s.why: whether sounds lead or trail the move they answer; 30 ms is about a frame either side at 30 fps, under the ~45 ms where audio-visual sync starts to feel loose

sound.sync.p10.why: the earliest-leading sounds: anticipation is a deliberate choice in some hands

sound.sync.p90.why: the latest-trailing sounds: a hand that lets sounds land after the move feels heavier

sound.sync.median_abs_offset_s.why: how tight the binding is overall, regardless of direction

sound.music.lufs.why: bed loudness; 2 LU is about the smallest change a listener reliably notices in a bed

sound.music.tempo_bpm.why: tempo sets the pulse the cuts and moves ride; 4% is where a groove starts to feel different

sound.music.duck_db_under_vo.why: how far the bed gets out of the voice's way; measured at pause boundaries, which is noisy to about 2 dB, so the band is 3

sound.music.cuts_beat_lock.why: whether cuts sit at a consistent place in the beat (1 locked, about 0.15 random for 35 cuts); phase-free, so a tracker locked half a beat off still reads right

sound.music.cuts_on_beat_share.why: share of cuts within 70 ms of a tracked beat; compare with music.cuts_on_beat_chance, since at 136 BPM 0.32 is chance

class_mix_total_variation.why: share of events per class; a hand that is all clicks is not a hand that is all whooshes

level_db_rel_vo.why: per-class level against the voice (or the bed when level_ref is music); 3 dB is a clearly audible step

centroid_oct.why: per-class brightness in octaves of the amplitude-weighted centroid

attack_decay_ratio.why: per-class envelope; looser than duration because attack is a few ms on hits

bound_property_share.why: which move properties a class is tied to

per_class.min_events_why: a class with fewer events than this in the source is reported, not scored
